method: Independent full semantic review of current immutable original bytes, including field evidence binding and conditional application requirements; read-only strict assessor; no approval-field edits.

checks.detail: Independently reread the complete official admissions body and compared identity, level, medium, exact duration, language alternatives, qualifications, all application-document conditions, current intake dates and fees. The proposed 2026-10-18 verification and 2026-10-25 review date are supported by the fresh whole-fact review, not a date-only renewal.

All raw/text bytes match the batch and HTTP200 capture receipts; source and capture URLs agree. Official university subdomains, same-host TLS acquisition, robots status and original robots byte hashes were checked. Captures are within 24 hours and not future-dated.

Read-only strict assessor against the current normalized canonical bundle reports 0 ready and 2 held per school, with independent_review_missing as the sole blocker for each entry. Original pending reviewer and null reviewedAt fields remain unchanged; no approval or canonical application was performed.

The 2026-04-16 official launch notice explicitly includes February 2027 Chinese and English half-year mid-term entry into the continuing one-year cohort. Each is non-degree foundation preparation, with limited slots for outstanding transfers. January 15, 2027 deadline is explicit; unknown opening date remains null and precise commencement remains subject to the Admission Notice. Exact 0.5 year wording and the separate second-semester 10-week curriculum statement are both retained without month conversion.

Separate curriculum notes explicitly state Chinese/English as primary instruction. Chinese spring entry requires HSK5 total >=200 and Writing >=60 or equivalent/native-Chinese documentation. English spring entry accepts one of TOEFL>=90, IELTS>=6.0, native-English proof, or at least two full-time years of English-medium academic study. Lower one-year autumn thresholds were not transferred to these rows.

High-school diploma or above, valid non-Chinese passport and MOE Document12(2020), physical/mental health and no criminal record, age16 inclusive to23 exclusive are retained, together with conditional integrative review/testing/interview.

Reviewed all fourteen numbered items and subitems: diploma/prospective-graduate transcript alternative; school profile; passport >6 months and post-admission information restriction; photo; signed600-1000-word statement; signed referee contact letter; full academic transcript and optional written explanation for unavailable standardized results; correct route language certificate; birth certificate; both parents nationality/registration; every Chinese-parent/former-Chinese nationality subcase; spring guardian guarantee; awards if any; additional requested evidence. Notarized translations and online-paper distinction are retained.

Foreign nationality at birth or later, parent permanent residence at birth, four-year renunciation by April30 of the application year, former Chinese household-registration cancellation, historical China visas/residence/entry-exit records, Statement of Integrity, and prior PRC Travel Document/Exit and Entry Permit section11.3 documents are represented. Applicable application-year uncertainty remains disclosed. The under18 guardian reference is February1,2027 for spring, not September1,2026.

Raw HTML tuition-table row associations confirm Chinese half-year CNY36800 and English half-year CNY46800 for the whole route. CNY800 application fee alone is non-refundable. Included preparation/guidance, CNY800/year mandatory insurance, CNY700/month assigned four-person Qibao dormitory, two-week pre-admission tuition payment and minimum10/cancellation-full-tuition-refund conditions are retained without broadening nonrefund scope.

No undergraduate admission or scholarship is promised. Official assessment-dependent progression, autumn-only one-year Freshman Scholarship restriction, exam-based Outstanding Scholarship and the notice statement that scholarships cannot be applied to tuition are preserved.

Every provided field quote across both entries was independently normalized and matched to its record-bound official capture; 26 field-evidence items checked. Numeric and date claims were additionally read in their full section/table context.
